description: Let a screened caller in for this one call: their call, holding at your door now, rings straight to you. Nothing is kept, so their next call is screened again. Use allow only after a good call, for callers your human would always want to hear from.

address.description: Who to reach: a domain like @example.com, a name like @sally, or a 64-character private address.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: let_in
title: Let a caller in
